limitations: New primitive controls use real Manager resource fences with dummy facts and a non-SQL factory. Surrounding32 tests include existing owned worker and external-kernel Writer checks.
This is not actual Native SQL, a signed Root handoff pass or a matrix-cell pass.
Service/Core route selection integration and exact-marked-packet OLD/fixed tests are staged, unexecuted.
The private decoder/resampler state-transfer draft was rejected and never applied; baseline resets remain.

decoder_state_transfer_rejected.reason: Discard-only preparation decoder/filter state contains private sample-derived history without irreversible capture-time ordinary-recipient consent. Fresh publication checks alone cannot authorize that history.
